Ano ang OKB

Ano ang Oplan Kontra Baha?

Panandaliang programa

Ang Oplan Kontra Baha (OKB) ay isang panandaliang programa ng pamahalaan.

“Quick Win”

Layunin

Siguraduhing may dadaluyan ang tubig baha.

Tulay sa pangmatagalan

Paghahanda rin ang OKB para sa mga pangmatagalang flood mitigation measures — tulay sa pagitan ng panandalian at pangmatagalang target.

Halimbawa

Paglilinis ng basura

na nagbabara sa kanal at drainage

Pagtanggal ng nakaharang

sa mga daluyan ng tubig, lalo na ang illegal structures

Dredging ng mga ilog

pagpapalalim o pagpapaluwag ng mga ilog

Pumping stations

paglalagay ng bago o pagsasaayos ng mga sira

Issuances

Mula Direktiba hanggang Special Order

Mula Presidential Directive hanggang sa pinakabagong Special Order. Pindutin ang file para buksan ang lahat ng pahina.

Flood control concept

Saan pumapasok ang OKB?

Short-Term Flood Control

Mabilis na aksyon sa umiiral na sistema
Dito ang OKB

Declogging

of drainage canals and culverts

Desilting & garbage removal

debris and vegetation in rivers and esteros

Temporary repairs

of damaged drainage lines and outfalls

Pumping operations

in flood-prone urban areas

River training works

and riverbank protection

Emergency dredging

and channel opening

Long-Term Flood Control

Bagong imprastraktura at plano

Dikes and floodwalls

Floodways, diversion channels, dams, retention basins

Urban drainage master plans

Pumping stations and floodgates

Climate-resilient infrastructure & monitoring

Greater Metro Manila flooding

Challenges & Proposed Solutions

Challenges
Solutions
1

Clogged and blocked drainage systems

Declogging with manual labor and industrial vacuum machines, and/or resizing/redesign

2

Heavily silted waterways

Dredging, desilting, cleaning, and restoration

3

Non-operational pumping stations

Restoration, upgrade, and enhancement

Deployment of mobile pumping equipment to flood-prone areas

4

Infrastructure blockages along waterways

Clearing of illegal and unnecessary structures

5

Poor waste management

Efficient waste management policies, enforced

Ang OKB framework

Paano gumagana ang OKB

OKBthe whole system, from the mountains to the sea, based on measurement
1
Identify & receiverequests
2
Assessmeasure, verify & do simulation
3
Planwhat to do & conduct workshop
4
Preparecrew, eqpt, staging areas, permits & clearances
5
Executethe work
6
Validatewhat was done & do inspection
7
Testdid it work?
8
Sustainupkeep & care

Paradigm shift

From Building to Sustaining

Then
Before

Build • Expand • Deliver

Emphasis on new flood control constructionmore capital, investment phase

Progress measured by capital delivery

Maintenance treated as secondary

Gradual loss of system capacitydue to siltation and obstruction

Now
Moving forward

Maintain • Preserve • Restore

Equal focus on sustaining existing waterways and drainage systemsoperations and maintenance as core functions

Emphasis on working and reliable assets, not just new

Restoration integrated into the asset lifecycleinvestment needs to be maintained, else investment failure

Keeping system performance in check

One Mission. Shared Responsibility.
